quantities.authorUnits: Original transit_depth and tran_unc are fractions; multiplying by 100 converts both to NASA percentage units. Original wv_center and wv_wdth are micrometers.

selection.method: Nearest existing NASA bin to each fixed teaching anchor; no averaging, interpolation or fit
selection.selectionPurpose: Contrast adjacent continuum/shoulder/feature regions for a guided educational example, not a statistically representative sample or independent detection.
selection.sourcePrecision: NASA values retained at their published five-decimal precision; full precision is retained separately in authorOriginal.

checks.comparisonAbsoluteTolerance: 0.00001 in each displayed NASA numeric unit (one last displayed digit)
checks.reasonForTolerance: Archive formatting/ingestion is not exactly equivalent to one-step rounding of the author file in every bin. Seven wavelength/width fields differ by just over half a last displayed digit; all fields agree within one displayed digit. No NASA numbers are replaced or regenerated.

limitations: Reduced, published measurements are used; these are not live telemetry, raw detector counts, or newly acquired observations.
Six distinct wavelength bins from one observed transit are delivered during a simulated educational mission; they are not six independent exposures or three paired measurements.

The retained source gives per-bin uncertainties but not a covariance matrix. Shared processing and astrophysical assumptions may correlate bins; the app must not treat bins as statistically independent or compute a detection significance.
The six-bin selection does not reproduce the 95-bin fit, molecular retrieval, abundance estimates or reported full-study detection significance.
The 4.3 micrometer feature is interpreted using the peer-reviewed full study. CO2 does not demonstrate life.
Planet artwork is illustrative; Webb did not directly image WASP-39 b or its atmosphere in this observation.
Spacecraft masses, power loads, budgets, communication windows and mission elapsed times remain transparent gameplay assumptions, not specifications recovered from this spectrum.
